mutations.name: a MERGE goes to the merge decision whatever its attestation
mutations.find: return attestDeclineRoute(run.reviews, run.target.pr, routed, (payload) => woken(run, "review", headSha, payload));
kills: a reviewer's declined attestation attest-unmet with only no-meeter rows sends back to the implementer with the bump instruction

mutations.name: the review wake brief ignores a declined attestation
kills: a reviewer's declined attestation attest-unmet with only no-meeter rows sends back to the implementer with the bump instruction

mutations.name: any unmet row sends back, an author meeter included
mutations.find: declined.every((row): row is DeclinedStep => row.by !== undefined && STEP_NAME.test(row.step))
kills: a reviewer's declined attestation attest-unmet meeter-is-author still raises approve-merge
an adversary's declined attestation (TP-5902) no adversary verdict at all still raises approve-merge on adversary-missing

mutations.name: an adversary's decline keeps the owner gate, as before TP-5902
kills: an adversary's declined attestation (TP-5902) an adversary MERGE with no Attests line, as on #3291, sends back once with a brief that names the adversary

mutations.name: the send-back has no cap
kills: a reviewer's declined attestation a send-back past the cap raises approve-merge
